title: Natural rubber supplier quality scorecard, July to September 2026
about: Lot-level quality trending of incoming natural rubber lots by supplier. Lot acceptance follows the incoming inspection limits for dirt, volatile matter and Mooney viscosity.
findings: Supplier B and Supplier D account for 8 of the 9 rejected lots.
Moisture findings at receipt rose in August, when the monsoon was at its peak, which points to contamination and moisture control during transport.
Both suppliers received a supplier corrective action request with the lot data attached, through the supplier feedback loop.
note: Synthetic sample written for the RPG NeuralMesh demonstration. It is not a record of the RPG Group.
